001package org.clafer.frontend;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Map;
006
007/**
008 * The scopes that chocosolver solves an explicit model with, as the compiler
009 * writes them to the explicit model's scope file ({@code clafer -m clafer
010 * --meta-data}, {@code model.des.cfr-scope}).
011 *
012 * @param clafers the scope of every clafer, by UID, sorted, the enumerations
013 * and their literals included
014 * @param intLow the smallest integer, {@code --minint} or -128
015 * @param intHigh the largest integer, {@code --maxint} or 127
016 * @param stringLength the length of the longest string literal, with its
017 * quotes, at least 16
018 * @param decimalDigits the number of fractional digits of decimals, 0 if the
019 * model has none and no {@code --decimal-digits}
020 */
021public record Scopes(Map<String, Long> clafers, long intLow, long intHigh, int stringLength, long decimalDigits) {
022
023    /**
024     * chocosolver's largest decimal, {@code Integer.MAX_VALUE / 100 - 1},
025     * scaled.
026     */
027    private static final long MaxScaledDecimal = 21474835;
028
029    /**
030     * @return the scope file, as the compiler writes it
031     * ({@code Explicit.explicitScopes})
032     */
033    public String scopeFile() {
034        List<String> entries = new ArrayList<>();
035        clafers.forEach((uid, scope) -> entries.add("{\"lpqName\": \"" + uid + "\", \"scope\": " + scope + "}"));
036        entries.add("{\"defaultScope\": 1}");
037        entries.add("{\"int\": [" + intLow + ", " + intHigh + "]}");
038        entries.add("{\"mul\": [" + intLow + ", " + intHigh + "]}");
039        entries.add("{\"stringLength\": " + stringLength + "}");
040        entries.add("{\"chars\": [32, 126]}");
041        entries.add("{\"decimalDigits\": " + decimalDigits + "}");
042        entries.add("{\"decimal\": [" + unscaled(-MaxScaledDecimal) + ", " + unscaled(MaxScaledDecimal) + "]}");
043        return "[\n" + String.join(",\n", entries) + "\n]\n";
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * A scaled decimal as written, e.g., 214748.35 for 21474835 with 2
048     * digits.
049     */
050    private String unscaled(long n) {
051        String digits = Long.toString(Math.abs(n));
052        int scale = (int) decimalDigits;
053        String padded = "0".repeat(Math.max(0, scale + 1 - digits.length())) + digits;
054        String whole = padded.substring(0, padded.length() - scale);
055        String fraction = padded.substring(padded.length() - scale);
056        return (n < 0 ? "-" : "") + whole + (scale > 0 ? "." + fraction : "");
057    }
058}
